title: Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture
summary: It names the patterns of business applications, such as repository and unit of work. The canon of this site uses the first edition (2002), ISBN 9780321127426.

title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture, Volume 1: A System of Patterns
summary: It names the architectural patterns, such as layers, pipes and filters, and broker. The canon of this site uses the first edition (1996), ISBN 9780471958697.

title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture, Volume 2: Patterns for Concurrent and Networked Objects
summary: It names the patterns of concurrent and networked software, such as reactor and active object. The canon of this site uses the first edition (2000), ISBN 9780471606956.
